license: Apache-2.0 (mlx2 LICENSE); original code, no third-party text copied; no Apple copyright header. The subject adapter keeps its own oMLX Apache-2.0 attribution and reads the installed MLX kernel headers (MIT, Apple Inc.) at kernel-build time; this harness only hashes those installed files and copies none of them.

subject.frozen: all three hashes are pinned in the harness (FROZEN) and re-checked at admission, after import and before every dispatch; the harness never edits them
used: admit / MoEPrefillRequest / projection_plan / Plan (expected plans, pinned sweep)
validate_sorted_routes (routes carrying the ordinary _gather_sort order) and sort_routes_host (run/pad cross-check)
ENGAGEMENT successful-chain counters (fresh deltas per call)
the import-captured native class, only for a separate dispatch of its own tile scan (_tiles) on the same sorted ids
read_mlx_headers (hash of the flattened header text it builds) and tile_table_host (cross-check of the independent tile law)
subject.states: implemented research candidate; NOT qualified, NOT selected, NOT observed-used; this harness cannot flip those

reference.path: served local layer code on the same sorted assignments: switch_layers._gather_sort (mx.argsort order, its tie order, its > 32768-row seam pad) -> QuantizedSwitchLinear.__call__ holding the fused [gate | up] table (mx.gather_qmm sorted_indices=True, transpose, affine 4-bit g64, bf16) -> switch_layers.SwiGLU (compiled activations.swiglu) on gate_up[..., :I] / gate_up[..., I:] exactly as FusedGateUpSwitchGLU splits it -> down QuantizedSwitchLinear sorted -> _scatter_unsort
reference.witnesses: exact source lines of that path in the three files are required at admission (REFERENCE_WITNESSES); their hashes are bound
reference.not_used: no handwritten SiLU, upstream LUT, fp32 proxy or candidate-internal helper as reference; quantized arithmetic is never changed

design_patterns_read: scripts/qualify_tensor_fa_research.py: source-before-MLX admission, evidence-vs-execution split and live-run witness re-implemented here (not imported); its attention tolerances, host float64 softmax and SDPA baseline are NOT used

gate.comparison: bf16 outputs compared as raw uint16 bits, zero mismatches; non-finite bit patterns in either arm fail even when identical; exact shapes; reference nonzero fraction >= 0.5; no tolerance of any kind
gate.routes: sorted ids equal router ids[order] and the order-independent host law, nondecreasing, seam pad rows repeat the last row, inv_order a permutation, the ordinary replicated x equals x_tokens[row_map]; the same tie order feeds both arms
gate.restoration: candidate chain (candidate gate/up -> candidate down) restored by _scatter_unsort equals the reference restoration bit for bit; both restorations equal the host inverse of their sorted rows
gate.engagement: every candidate call: exactly one fresh native successful chain of its kind and no other counter movement, paired with its evaluated, checked output; the run total must equal the evaluated native stages and the catalogue's expected count
gate.scan_probe: separate dispatch of the candidate's own tile scan on the same sorted ids per tile height used: count within capacity, equal to an independent tile law, every row covered exactly once by single-expert tiles of at most bm rows
gate.native_stamp: only native_verdict(live) on an in-process _LiveNativeRun built by _run_native with the real NativeBackend, the full mandatory catalogue and clean post-run source/build/module checks

catalogue.cells: per geometry: row-block boundary (T128 / T205) uniform and interleaved-empty-subset, ragged uniform, hot edge experts with full-length runs, Zipf-skewed with empty experts, a planner + six pinned plan sweep, one > 32768 sorted-row seam pad control (T4097 pad 56 / T3277 pad 62); decode T1, MTP verify T4 and one-below-admission cells refused before any backend
catalogue.inputs: seed-bound host numpy: router ids by Gumbel top-k (k distinct experts per token), bf16 token rows, and affine q4 g64 tables generated directly in packed form (uniform 4-bit codes, bf16 scales in [0.006, 0.014), biases -scale * U[7, 8)); one geometry's tables live at a time and one cell at a time

system Metal headers (metal_stdlib, MetalPerformancePrimitives), the Metal compiler and the OS are not hash-bound; the run records platform.platform() and device_info only. The utils.h preamble mx.fast.metal_kernel prepends is compiled into libmlx (bound by the libmlx hash); the installed preamble headers are hashed but not proven identical to it

the scan probe is a separate dispatch of the candidate's own scan on the same sorted ids, not the scan instance inside an evaluated chain; chain coverage is evidenced by the bit identity of the evaluated outputs
successful-chain counters count lazy chains, not GPU executions; nativeness is evidence association (import-time class/witness capture), not protection against arbitrary in-process code
both arms use the tie order of one mx.argsort run; tie-order invariance across runs is not claimed
the reference QuantizedSwitchLinear is created with __new__ + nn.Module.__init__ (its __init__ would draw random weights) and holds the synthetic tables; its served __call__ is used unchanged
two named geometries, affine 4-bit g64 bf16, synthetic uniform 4-bit codes only; no generic-shape, model, state, batching or performance claim
the full-catalogue fake test peaks near 2.5 GB host RSS
